lead: A toggle button with two states, pressed and released; it writes `data-pressed` when pressed. ToggleGroup manages a set of them: single choice by default, several with `multiple`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `toggle.css`. The pressed colour comes from the soft / text values of `--ui-c-*`; the soft variant turns solid when pressed.
styling.slot: A single button and a group of buttons
styling.pressed: Written on the toggle when it is pressed
styling.group: Whether the group is attached, and its direction
